lesson.title: Journeys, Tickets & Transit
lesson.subtitle: High-speed trains, flights, tickets, and getting around
lesson.description: Talk about traveling by high-speed rail, plane, boat, car, or bike, checking tickets, luggage, and delays.

learning_objectives: Name vehicles and travel essentials: 高铁, 汽车, 船, 自行车, 护照, 行李, 地图, 宾馆, and 游客.
Discuss departures, arrivals, and delays: 出发, 离开, 起飞, 检票, 接, 经过, and 晚点.
Navigate streets and traffic with 马路, 路口, 红绿灯, and 骑.

metadata.audience: HSK 3.0 Level 3 learners with Level 1-2 foundations

overview.topic_description: Travel, transit, and road-navigation vocabulary for trips and commutes.
overview.focus: Use 骑 for riding bikes/horses, 坐 for trains/planes/cars, and 晚点 when a train or flight is delayed.

questions.prompt: Which verb means "to be delayed / late (of transport)"?
questions.explanation: 晚点 means a train, bus, or flight is delayed.
接 means to meet/pick up someone.

dialogue.title: Catching the High-Speed Train
dialogue.context_en: Xiao Zhou and his friend arrive at the station to take a high-speed train.

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 护照和车票都带了吗？前面路口有红绿灯，咱们过马路吧。
turns.pinyin: Hùzhào hé chēpiào dōu dài le ma? Qiánmiàn lùkǒu yǒu hóng-lǜdēng, zánmen guò mǎlù ba.
turns.english: Did you bring your passport and ticket? There’s a traffic light at the intersection ahead—let’s cross the street.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 都带着呢，行李也不重。咱们几点出发去检票？
turns.pinyin: Dōu dài zhe ne, xíngli yě bú zhòng. Zánmen jǐ diǎn chūfā qù jiǎnpiào?
turns.english: I have both, and my luggage isn’t heavy. What time do we head to ticket inspection?

turns.speaker: A
turns.hanzi: 八点半开车，现在已经可以检票了。但愿这趟高铁别晚点。
turns.pinyin: Bā diǎn bàn kāichē, xiànzài yǐjīng kěyǐ jiǎnpiào le. Dànyuàn zhè tàng gāotiě bié wǎndiǎn.
turns.english: It leaves at 8:30, so we can check tickets now. Hopefully this high-speed train isn’t delayed.

turns.speaker: B
turns.hanzi: 到了以后我表哥会开车来接我们去宾馆。
turns.pinyin: Dào le yǐhòu wǒ biǎogē huì kāichē lái jiē wǒmen qù bīnguǎn.
turns.english: After we arrive, my cousin will drive to pick us up and take us to the hotel.

patterns.title: Picking someone up with 接
patterns.explanation_en: Use 来 / 去 + 接 + person to mean going or coming to pick someone up at a station, airport, or school.

examples.hanzi: 下午我去机场接一位外国游客。
examples.pinyin: Xiàwǔ wǒ qù jīchǎng jiē yí wèi wàiguó yóukè.
examples.english: This afternoon I am going to the airport to pick up a foreign tourist.

examples.hanzi: 爸爸每天五点开车去接妹妹放学。
examples.pinyin: Bàba měitiān wǔ diǎn kāichē qù jiē mèimei fàngxué.
examples.english: Dad drives to pick up my younger sister from school every day at five.

patterns.title: Passing by or through with 经过
patterns.explanation_en: 经过 (jīngguò) means to pass through a place on the way somewhere.

examples.hanzi: 这路汽车经过图书馆门口。
examples.pinyin: Zhè lù qìchē jīngguò túshūguǎn ménkǒu.
examples.english: This bus route passes by the library entrance.

examples.hanzi: 回家的路上我们经过一个很大的路口。
examples.pinyin: Huí jiā de lùshang wǒmen jīngguò yí ge hěn dà de lùkǒu.
examples.english: On the way home we passed through a very big intersection.

reading.title: A Smooth Trip by Train and Boat

paragraphs.hanzi: 上个月，小吴带着简单的行李坐高铁去南方旅游。高铁准时出发，没有晚点，三个小时就到了。
paragraphs.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè, Xiǎo Wú dài zhe jiǎndān de xíngli zuò gāotiě qù nánfāng lǚyóu. Gāotiě zhǔnshí chūfā, méiyǒu wǎndiǎn, sān ge xiǎoshí jiù dào le.
paragraphs.english: Last month, Xiao Wu took light luggage and rode the high-speed train to travel in the south. The train departed on time without delay and arrived in three hours.

paragraphs.hanzi: 住进宾馆以后，他拿着地图去湖边坐船。湖面上风很凉快，船上还有不少拍照的游客。
paragraphs.pinyin: Zhù jìn bīnguǎn yǐhòu, tā ná zhe dìtú qù húbiān zuò chuán. Húmiàn shàng fēng hěn liángkuai, chuán shàng hái yǒu bùshǎo pāizhào de yóukè.
paragraphs.english: After checking into the hotel, he took a map and went to the lake to ride a boat. The breeze on the lake was cool, and there were quite a few tourists taking photos on the boat.

questions.prompt_en: How long did the high-speed train trip take?
What did Xiao Wu do after checking into the hotel?
questions.answer_en: He took a map and went to the lake to ride a boat.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Describe how you usually travel between cities and why.

model_answer.hanzi: 去附近的城市我喜欢坐高铁，又快又不容易晚点。
model_answer.pinyin: Qù fùjìn de chéngshì wǒ xǐhuan zuò gāotiě, yòu kuài yòu bù róngyì wǎndiǎn.
model_answer.english: To nearby cities I like taking the high-speed train—it’s fast and not easily delayed.

speaking_tasks.scenario_en: Talk about a time you picked someone up or went to a hotel.

model_answer.hanzi: 朋友来玩儿时，我去火车站接他，然后一起去宾馆。
model_answer.pinyin: Péngyou lái wánr shí, wǒ qù huǒchēzhàn jiē tā, ránhòu yìqǐ qù bīnguǎn.
model_answer.english: When my friend came to visit, I went to the train station to pick him up, then we went to the hotel together.

teaching_plan.common_pitfall: Use 骑 (qí) only for straddling vehicles/animals (骑自行车, 骑马); use 坐 for trains, planes, boats, and buses, and 开 for driving a car.
teaching_plan.pronunciation_focus: 红绿灯 (hóng-lǜdēng) keeps the rounded vowel ü in lǜ; 高铁 (gāotiě) moves from flat gāo to low third-tone tiě.

can_do: Name vehicles and travel items like 高铁, 护照, and 行李.
Talk about departing, checking tickets, and delays.
Give street directions with 马路, 路口, and 红绿灯.
